scope: Separate whole-pipeline list from freshly authorized single-applicant detail; retain full-set filtering, sorting, counts, kanban and quick-review semantics. Pagination remains a separately tested next step.

measurement.percentiles: Existing nearest-rank function; p95 equals maximum at n=10. Descriptive local results, not a production percentile estimate.
measurement.fixture: Identical within each cohort: 3 synthetic 1024-character essays, 1050-character biography, 2 added experiences and 2 submitted evaluations across 2 rounds per applicant; no booking history. Seeded 100 applicants also retain their original experience.
measurement.controls: Frozen production outputs, one loopback app and database, identical pool limit 8, one desktop Chromium client, keyboard navigation and pointer detail selection, no concurrent builds/tests during collection.
measurement.failurePolicy: Retain every warmup/measurement and stop on missing samples, browser errors, HTTP errors or missing workspace body counters. No outlier removal.
measurement.successfulFlightCancellation: After the first strict attempt stopped on baseline net::ERR_ABORTED: separately count only HTTP 200 getRecruitmentCycles Flight cancellations with no cycle-error UI, no page errors and CDP received-byte counters. All other cancellations/errors stop collection. Retain the stopped attempt and every observation.

security: Original live verified identity/session/member/capability/suspension/support/privacy projection on both contracts. No authorization cache. Private no-store, Vary Cookie, Demo adapters and voting snapshot checks preserved.
restrictions: No production infrastructure, configuration, database/schema/index changes, caching library, merge or deployment.
